name: JokInTheBox staking unstake() never clears the stake
summary: JokInTheBoxStaking.unstake(stakeIndex) paid principal plus the lock bonus without clearing or marking the stake, so the attacker unstaked the same index repeatedly until the contract's 109.1B JOK were gone, then sold the JOK on Uniswap.
notes: The JOK drained was several times what the JOK/WETH pool could absorb, so it is valued at what the attacker realised (rule 12): 9.12 ETH from its four sales in refs.
